## Codev governance docs

Feature-scale changes (rough guide: >300 lines, or a new user-facing surface) must land the
Spec / Plan / Review trail in this same PR. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the
"Contributing WITHOUT the builder machinery" section of CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md. Tick what applies:

- [ ] Spec — `codev/specs/<PR#>-<name>.md`
- [ ] Plan — `codev/plans/<PR#>-<name>.md`
- [ ] Review — `codev/reviews/<PR#>-<name>.md`
- [ ] Small change / docs only — exempt (no Codev docs required)
